template.source: PilotPill · founder's coded swipe file (UVT = us vs them) · sorted F1 by sort-ad
template.production_method: flat design — headline band, two cards each with a photo of a hand holding one tablet, two 3-line tick lists, rounded button; gpt-image-2 for the two hands, everything else by script

decode.scroll_stop_trick: A pun headline, then two hands holding what looks like the same thing, and the lists tell you which one to pick.
decode.hidden_reading: 'a hard man' — the pun is the hook; ours mirrors it on the man's belly: 'a flat man'
decode.scene_logic: no scene, two product cards. Ours: a water tablet (what he takes before a beach photo) vs the Edenvia tablet
decode.visual_trick: two near-identical hand photos holding a small round tablet, blue card vs light card — copy literally; the only difference is the tablet
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: blue tablet ↔ a plain white 'water tablet'; weekend tablet ↔ the white Edenvia tablet (identical look: the lists make the difference, as in the template)
decode.render_style: flat design, navy headline band, pale blue card left, royal blue card right, photo hands on white tiles
decode.text_treatment: bold serif headline white, card titles in light serif, tick lines regular sans, green rounded button

strategy.angle: A8-M the man's belly that isn't fat — 'the keg that stays after the diet'
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: sucks his gut in for every photo · cause: fluid and inflamed tissue, not beer fat · tried: water tablets before an event, cutting beer for a month
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.
